about_the_game:
Choose three heroes and venture out on dangerous quests. You'll be balancing battling with dodging, all while managing your party's stamina levels to ensure they can stay in the fight! Each run will take you through numerous areas while you build up your party with stat points, skills, and powerful items. With a wide cast of heroes, a boat load of monsters, and a trove of items, each run will be tense and different in its own way!

Key Features

  • Three's a Party - Build a party of three, chosen from a cast of over 15 varied heroes all with their own abilities and skill pools.

  • Stamina Matters - Manage your party's energy levels as you fight to ensure you can keep going!

  • Always Swapping - Swap between your party members with no drawback, ensuring you always use the right one for the right moment.

Tons of Stuff

  • Power Up - Build your party with stat points and unique abilities, then equip them with more than 40 different items.

  • Roguelike Inspired - Interact with pieces of the environment itself via damage types or elemental abilities. Take down monsters in more ways than just bonking them on the head!

  • Tons of Towers - Trudge through 9+ different areas, all with their own inhabitants and level generation styles.

  • Monsters Galore - 20+ enemy types, as well as 5+ fearsome bosses to challenge.

short_description: Triple Swap Tower is a frantic roguelite which puts you in control of three different heroes. Swap fast between them as you fell waves of enemies, then power them up! How will you build your party?
